verdict: Neither the installed firmware nor the withdrawn candidate has stock Bluetooth parity

reviewers.scope: Radio reports, controls, recovery, input and test oracles
Power, USB, indicators, idle and left wake

baseline.status: Existing baseline with verified defects; restoring it is not a parity fix

findings.title: Status changes lose releases and synthesise key transitions
observations: Stock sends reports in public states2..6; installed QMK accepts only state4.
After A-down completes, queue A-up then receive b6 00 00: stock sends the release; QMK clears it.
After Shift+A completes, receive b6 00 00 then b6 00 02 with no key change: stock sends nothing; QMK sends zero keyboard/system/consumer reports then the held state again.
findings.required: Treat report eligibility, retained releases and resynchronisation as one conformance problem; public state4 is not authority to discard or replay HID state.

findings.title: Recovery conflates short frames, SPI errors, receive-only activity and command timeout
observations: Short zero A1 completion: stock retains pending report, lowers PC14, keeps PD1 low, rearms and guards retry for20callbacks.
SPI error during A1: stock retains pending report, keeps PC14 high and PD1 low, rearms through backend cleanup and guards retry.
Receive-only CS with no outgoing command has no stock command timeout; QMK resets after2000ms.
Full command timeout pulses PD1 but stock retains public status and pending control; QMK clears them.
Stock visible Caps cache and timer survive transport and callback restarts.
Stock initial startup has four attempts and consumes B6field2 counter updates; the installed driver retries indefinitely and ignores that field.
findings.required: Implement cause-specific recovery and preserve the appropriate command, request-pin and display state.

findings.title: Control intent is lost on timeout and is not cancelled cleanly on shutdown
observations: With retry budget3, time out slot2 pairing selection: stock retries aa 03 02; QMK sends A7 then remains ready with pending_slot0 and pair_requested1.
Interrupted aa 00 01 has the same intent-lifetime problem.
Native QMK shutdown during PAIR_DELAY sends aa 00 01 before release reports; exact stock shutdown equivalence was not established.
findings.required: Retain a control until completion or explicit cancellation, and cancel all pairing stages on shutdown or supersession.

findings.title: Unavailable transport consumes macros and full queues delay USB escape
observations: Compiled abc macro during RESET_HIGH completes after7ms with queue0 and latest all-up; no events remain to replay.
Stock ordinary-key input during reset retains A-down and defers A-up until the press can be built.
With16queued reports, requesting USB spends2000ms in clear_keyboard/enqueue before switching the active driver.
findings.comparison_scope: Stock ordinary-key deferral was executed; the full stock macro player was not. The stall is bounded in the supplied scheduler and does not prove an indefinite hardware hang.
findings.required: Include transport/control readiness in playback backpressure; preserve undelivered input and make foreground host selection responsive.

findings.title: Manual output changes erase physically held modifiers
observations: Hold Shift on Bluetooth, select USB then Bluetooth without releasing Shift, press J: stock sends mods02/J; QMK clears real modifiers and sends mods00/J.
findings.required: Separate old-host release from deletion of physical key/modifier state.

findings.title: Pairing and short selection do not follow the current chord predicates
observations: Release Pn at100ms while F1 remains held to3000ms: QMK pairs; stock does not match the current chord.
Stock defers short selection while another ordinary key is held and consumes it after all keys are released; QMK selects immediately on profile-key release.
QMK's numerical3000ms threshold is correct; the missing predicates are the defect.
findings.required: Use current chord, key-change timing and deferred all-keys-up/report-readiness conditions.

findings.title: Overlapping consumer and system controls lose held bits
observations: Press first control, press second, release first: stock bitmap01→03→02; QMK01→02→00.
Verified consumer EC/ED against0183/018a and system E9/EA against0081/0082.
All18 individual consumer press/release mappings matched actual stock handling.
findings.required: Preserve usage and press/release identity before conversion to anonymous usage0, for both physical actions and macros.

findings.title: USB notices can be starved behind reports
observations: Stock prioritises a pending A7 notice over dirty A1 data. New QMK reports kept usb_notice set through40frames/400ms and can continue doing so.
findings.required: Give control notices explicit scheduling priority.

findings.title: USB resume loses held keys and modifiers
observations: Actual inlined QMK wake branch clears real/weak modifiers and report keys while matrix_previous remains unchanged.
Shift+A before resume then B while still holding them produces00 00 05... instead of retaining Shift+A.
Stock IRQ suspend/resume retains02 00 04... and its dirty flag, and requests remote resume for a pending report.
findings.required: Preserve or correctly reconstruct physical input through USB wake.
findings.limitation: Physical USB remote-wake signalling and timing were not measured.

findings.title: USB power handover omits stock state, persistence and control cancellation
observations: Accepted USB configuration saves USB output; for public radio state3/4 stock also cancels pending pairing/control and invokes transport recovery. QMK selects USB without those actions.
During USB suspend stock public state5→0 clears charge eligibility; QMK retains configuration1 and eligibility.
Resume through state2→5 saves/selects USB in stock; QMK can remain on Bluetooth.
Retained configuration after USB power removal can make QMK choose USB on power-bank reconnection without enumeration, while stock remains Bluetooth.
Manual Pn+2 is a different path and does not perform stock's automatic radio reset.
findings.required: Use the active USB/power state transitions rather than retained configuration alone, and reproduce persistence/cancellation.
findings.limitation: The battery-backed physical unplug sequence remains unverified.

findings.title: Radio activity, pairing expiry and PA10-deferred power do not follow stock idle policy
observations: Stock refreshes activity in non-idle radio callback states; QMK lacks equivalent radio activity refresh.
After pairing indication times out, stock caps remaining idle time at6000half-ms ticks; QMK can retain about260seconds.
PB12high/PA10high/public4 at the idle boundary defers the stock supply transition without requesting idle; QMK can idle using cached external=false.
QMK refreshes activity continuously for held keys; stock's ordinary matrix activity is change-driven.
findings.limitation: Complete deep-idle scan/clock restoration and physical held-key sleep duration were not executed.

findings.title: Foreground low-voltage polling does not enforce continuously low voltage
observations: For low10ms/high10ms/low10ms and foreground calls only at0/30ms, stock stays battery level7 with30filter ticks remaining; both QMK images drop to6.
findings.required: Make filter sampling independent of foreground delays.

findings.title: Slot and pairing indication depends on SPI progress
observations: Stock installs indication when accepting the user command. QMK waits for AA transmission after queued reports, so absent clocks can delay or suppress feedback.
findings.required: Start feedback at the stock command-acceptance boundary.

findings.title: Indicator priority and retained phases differ
observations: Low battery during pairing: stock red/blue0/6000; QMK6000/6000.
First charging burst requested1000ms after initialisation: stock blue6000; QMK0.
Reselect in an off phase at350ms: stock stays off with300half-ms ticks remaining; QMK immediately turns blue on.
findings.required: Reproduce mode priority and retained timer/phase state.

findings.title: Pairing incorrectly clears the retry budget
observations: Short selection clears stock's retry byte; pairing preserves it. Pairing from3 leaves stock3 but candidate0.
findings.compound_effect: After a completed short selection and one recoverable idle SPI error, candidate becomes phase6/public7/counter0; stock stays callback4/public2/counter0. The finite retry patch amplified the existing over-aggressive reset.

findings.title: Selection clears the displayed Caps cache using the wrong stock field
observations: Short selection during a Caps pulse: stock/installed red6000; candidate red0. PublicLED clears but display cache/timer remain.
findings.required: Compare equivalent observable state; preserve the display cache and its timer.

additional_protocol_difference.observation: Known invalid B6fields4/ff and B7fields1/3 leave stock's transmitting callback unchanged, allowing a full-length report acknowledgement. QMK retries every nonzero prefix. Unknown opcode99 does collide in stock.
additional_protocol_difference.required: Preserve parser-family validity distinctions without inventing RF meanings.

withdrawn_findings.correction: Stock seeds its counter to1;6000elapsed half-ms ticks produce6001 and correctly trigger at3000ms.

withdrawn_findings.claim: Original selection incorrectly retains visible LED state
withdrawn_findings.correction: The test compared stock publicLED1e5 with QMK's displayed cache, which corresponds to stock68b. Original visible retention is correct; the proposed clear was a regression.

coverage_failures: Supplied connected state before most scenarios hid state-transition defects.
Stable-state report tests did not exercise transitions during pending releases or active transfers.
Injected report buffers and direct pending-command writes established framing rather than full input/control behaviour.
Reconnect, short-frame and wake tests asserted implementation behaviour without the stock oracle.
The original selection test compared non-equivalent LED state and omitted pairing's retry-counter asymmetry.
Macro combinations reconnected before playback rather than interrupting it during playback.
Test counts are input-case counts, not complete transition or functionality coverage.
limitations: These findings do not establish the root cause of the last live missing Bluetooth J; internal installed driver state was not observed.
Radio reachability with the switch OFF under USB does not prove key delivery or identify switch wiring.
Full boot, RF/bonding, electrical SPI timing, USB signalling, charger behaviour, battery runtime and complete deep-sleep restoration remain unproved.
PA10's external role and interconnect supply/wake wiring remain unidentified.
Left software idle/link wake routes differ, but physical reachability with PB12low depends on board wiring.
No further firmware was flashed and no new manual key tests were requested during these reviews.
correction_order: Replace false oracles with end-to-end stock input, control and observable-output comparisons.
Correct report preservation, control lifetime and cause-specific recovery together.
Correct input readiness, handover and usage-release identity.
Correct USB/power/indicator transitions and sampling policy.
Run the expanded independent stock conformance audit before another candidate is offered for hardware validation.
